chunks: And the like of this has been narrated from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام, that he said:
"The Qur'an was not sent down except with wiping."

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Mu'minin; title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.أُنْزِلَ: was sent down; refers to divine revelation
key_terms.الْقُرْآنُ: the Qur'an; the revealed Book of Allah
key_terms.بِالْمَسْحِ: with wiping; indicating passing the hand over the limb in wudu (ablution)

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام relate the Qur'an to wiping in wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This report attributes to Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام a concise statement linking the Qur'anic teaching of wudu (ablution) to wiping rather than washing in the relevant limb. In context, it is used as evidence in jurisprudential discussion about the prescribed manner of performing wudu (ablution).
